title: Canvas Issue Extraction
overview: The canvas highlights delivery pressure around shifting client priorities, unclear ownership, and stretched coordination capacity.

issues.title: Weekly priority churn is destabilizing delivery focus
issues.why_it_matters: Frequent priority changes can disrupt planning, reduce delivery predictability, and increase context switching across the team.
signals: Two mid-level engineers are split across support work and new feature delivery.
open_questions: Which work items are most frequently being reshuffled?
Is there an agreed weekly planning checkpoint with the client?
recommended_next_steps: Introduce a visible weekly reprioritization checkpoint.
Separate protected delivery work from interrupt-driven support work.

issues.title: Unclear ownership is slowing escalations
issues.why_it_matters: If escalation paths are ambiguous, urgent issues take longer to resolve and stakeholder confidence can drop.
signals: Escalations are slow when ownership is unclear.
One delivery lead is handling planning and stakeholder alignment.
open_questions: Which decisions require explicit owners today?
Are engineering and stakeholder escalation paths currently distinct?
recommended_next_steps: Define named owners for operational and delivery escalation paths.
Publish a lightweight escalation matrix for the team and client.

issues.title: The team may be missing a stabilizing triage cadence
issues.why_it_matters: A visible triage rhythm can absorb changing priorities more deliberately and reduce reactive churn.
signals: A visible triage rhythm could reduce churn.
Senior engineering capacity is concentrated on a migration stream.
open_questions: Who should own the triage cadence?
How often should urgent support work be reviewed against migration commitments?
recommended_next_steps: Establish a recurring triage forum with clear intake rules.
Review support interrupts against migration commitments each cycle.
